card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions and punctuation in web-page text where a possessive such as our, my, your or their is likely to come next. Often seen in site notices, contact lines and user instructions.

card.writes: It promotes our and my (English and Chinese) and suppresses their and his forms such as 其 and himself.
card.plain: It fires where the next word is probably our or my, as in website notices written in the first person.
